decisions.reason: The Blockaid false-positive report and developer-verification submission do not change the Transak fiat-mint flow, provider, or buyer experience.
The requested Blockaid submission is unrelated to the site's customer-support contact form or its fields and placement.
Developer verification intended to prevent malicious-site warnings does not alter authentication requirements or access to public APIs.
The security-warning remediation does not change NFT referral-code identity, persistence, source, or display locations.
The Blockaid project-verification request does not affect the Discord server or its community configuration.
Blockaid developer verification is distinct from NFT metadata correctness and does not change any metadata attribute or source-of-truth rule.
The false-positive report and Blockaid submission do not alter transactional email delivery, provider configuration, or email contents.
The malicious-site warning remediation does not change NFT-holder eligibility, Lit Protocol gating, or book-access behavior.
Blockaid project verification is unrelated to Chainlink VRF selection, fairness, or draw applicability.
The source requests an external Blockaid verification submission and does not require any landing-page copy or layout change.
The security-warning remediation does not alter USDC payment, approval, mint execution, or contract scope.
The Blockaid false-positive and developer-verification actions do not entail any change to the approved product FAQ content.
